user_question: Create a raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for State College.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for State College.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve second State College elevation surface
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain the other available elevation surface needed for the comparison.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate elevation raster covering State College. The candidate must be suitable as the second elevation surface and must be returned as a GeoTIFF dataset. Do not assume candidate analytical fitness until runtime metadata is inspected.

workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation surface to reference grid
workflow_steps.purpose: Resample the retrieved elevation surface so it has a compatible CRS and aligned raster grid with input_1.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample elevation_surface_candidate to the grid of input_1, using 30 metre target resolution and preserving the elevation surface meaning. Runtime QC must verify CRS compatibility and full grid alignment with input_1 before allowing downstream raster calculation.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested raster showing the elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate the cell-by-cell elevation difference using input_1 and aligned_elevation_surface. Use the first surface minus the second surface as the difference direction. Execute only after runtime QC confirms compatible CRSs, aligned grids, supported GeoTIFF inputs, and valid raster metadata.

requirements.scope: The retrieved candidate must cover State College.
